==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a retro futuristic, space-age, metropolis. It is a floating city drifting through space. I help protect this city from danger.

The city is regularly threatened by aliens known as Akuman. During a battle against the Akuman, a fellow hero wearing a glowing blue watch is injured. I take the hero away from the battle to recover.

The hero's glowing blue watch asks for a passcode to emit ectoplasm. I help the hero's young sidekick figure out how to activate the watch. The watch activates and emits an ectoplasmic field that saves the injured hero.
